name: DPS Modern Indian School · Al Wakrah
accuracy: Approximate exterior campus study. Participant feedback identifies the west academic footprint as A Block, the central academic footprint as C Block, and the north-west area as a playground. A gap between A and C leads toward the volleyball and basketball courts. Building dimensions, heights and floor labels remain schematic. No interiors are modelled. Participant also identifies a stage facing the sports ground and a canteen at the ground-facing corner of C Block; both are approximate exterior landmarks. Latest participant correction: the external auditorium obscures part of the stadium-facing C Block facade; the canteen sits at that facade's corner beside the near edge of the stadium.
